Owlbear_Armoured
Through Dammon's special brew, the Owlbear Cub is transformed into the Armoured Owlbear.
“
Your owlbear cub - all grown up and ready to rage, wearing full armour.
 „


Involvement

The Armoured Owlbear can be summoned via  Gather Your Allies (class action) to fight alongside the party during Confront the Elder Brain. In order to use this ability, the party must successfully recruit the Owlbear Cub and Dammon must survive until the end the of the game.
